result.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model
result.summary: Laya answers typed multiple-choice questions in one forward pass by scoring a hidden state at one [MASK] marker per option. We re-engineer the checkpoint (421M parameters; a 2-layer option head with no positional tensor; a documented but unused parallel layout) and test whether the answer depends on where an option is listed. Presenting 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options (or six random permutations for 12 options), the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% [22.9-28.7] of questions (19.7% on the 605 English-language items alone); accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and the flips concentrate where the model's own confidence is low (54% versus 8% across confidence terciles). Fine-tuning with Laya's trainer on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%; the identical rows without shuffling give 11.4%, so shuffling is responsible for 4.2 points of the improvement. A confidence-weighted vote over orderings gives 69.7% against 69.1% for a single base pass at 4.1x the compute. Labels are LLM-made and the test sets are teacher-filtered. We also fine-tune with the authors' parallel layout on the same rows: flip rate 0.5%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文重新工程化非自回归决策模型 Laya（421M，一次前向在每个选项的 [MASK] 位置读取隐状态打分），在 951 道题的全部循环置换下检验答案是否随选项位置改变：25.8% 的题答案翻转，gold 在首位与末位时准确率差 10.1 点，翻转集中在低置信度题；用打乱选项的 2818 行微调把翻转率降到 7.2%，而置信度加权多顺序投票以 4.1 倍算力仅从 69.1% 提到 69.7%。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是对「latent 读出究竟读内容还是读位置」的直接诊断，与 LVR 中 latent 打分的位置混淆、并行多 marker 的注意力结构及顺序不变训练相关，可供核查；但材料为纯文本设定，迁移到视觉多模态读出需研究者自行判断。
